notes: The screen’s “Try the Sheet again” button now says what happened: “Connected – the Sheet answered at 08:40”, or why it still can’t

When the screen can’t reach the Sheet it now tells you which kind of problem it is: this PC can’t reach the internet/Google at all, or Google answered with an error (the script stopped or needs approving)

Children are now widgets: each child’s points card is a full-height widget you can put on any screen (four fit on one). Your points page has been turned into a screen of child widgets in the same place – move them about in Setup → Screen layout
A new child (Family & calendar → ⭐ Points) gets a widget of their own; renaming a child keeps theirs, and taking a child off points removes it (their points are kept)
Setup → Screen layout: no separate points screen to add any more – drag “Child (points)” from the widget list instead
